maudhui: (1) There shall be a Vice-President who shall be the principal assistant to the President in respect of all matters of the United Republic generally, and in particular - (a) shall assist the President in following up the day-to-day implementation of Union Matters; (b) shall perform all duties assigned to him by the President; (c) shall perform all the duties of the President when the President is absent from office or is out of the country. (2) Without prejudice to the provisions of Article 37(5), the Vice-President shall be elected at the same election together with the President. (3) A person shall be nominated to contest the office of Vice-President on the principle that where the President of the United Republic comes from one part of the Union, the Vice-President shall be a person who comes from the other part of the Union. (4) A person shall not be nominated to contest or hold the office of Vice-President unless - (a) he is a citizen of the United Republic by birth; (b) he has attained the age of forty years; (c) he is a member of, and a candidate proposed by, a political party; (d) he is qualified to be a Member of Parliament or a Member of the House of Representatives; and (e) within the period of five years before the election he has not been convicted of an offence relating to evasion to pay tax. (5) No political party shall be prohibited from nominating any person as a candidate for the office of Vice-President merely because that person holds the office of President of Zanzibar or Prime Minister. (6) The Vice-President shall not at the same time be a Member of Parliament, Prime Minister or President of Zanzibar. (7) Where a person who is Prime Minister or President of Zanzibar is nominated or elected Vice-President, he shall cease to hold the office of Prime Minister or President of Zanzibar, as the case may be. (8) The Vice-President shall discharge his duties under the direction and supervision of the President.
